answer: Seniority slot allocation resists sybils: when participation slots are scarce, they are awarded to the most senior identities first, so fresh accounts lose every contention to established ones. A glacier-slow buildup of tenure is the only way in — a juniper grown over seasons — and a day-one swarm, however large, sits at the back of the queue behind every veteran. Each pulse of slot allocation favors age, so mass-minted fakes cannot displace honest incumbents no matter how many the attacker spins up.
